measureRecords.whatItDoes: Continue the city’s existing 0.5% sales and use tax for ten more years, from January 1, 2030 through December 31, 2039, after its current expiration at the end of 2029. The question authorizes $2.5 million in the first extension year and whatever the tax raises later. Money could be used only for maintenance and improvements to streets identified in Resolution 7-2026. The extension would not raise the existing city sales-tax rate or city property taxes. Revenue could be collected and spent outside the stated constitutional and other legal limits.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Extend the existing street sales and use tax through 2039 for the specified streets and approve its revenue-limit exception.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not extend this tax beyond its current 2029 expiration or approve the proposed revenue-limit exception.
